text: Completed the frozen C04 affine-transfer experiment without retuning. Six paired exact-core affine cases produced C1 6/6 success, C4 4/6 success plus two retained inverse failures, and C5 6/6 success. Frozen penalty-aware C5-C4 mean RMS difference -33.6294 mm, exact 46,656-resample 95% interval [-66.7864,-0.4730]; four common-success pairs mean -0.4835 mm. C5 mean RMS 0.0793 mm versus C1 0.0444 mm, so the handoff improves the recipient but does not improve the standalone affine on affine-only truth.
